functions.name: wizard2.lua
functions.sourceReview: Read the complete nethack-c/upstream/dat/wizard2.lua source (lines 1-62), including both level_init and level_flags calls, the pre-map selection.match/bounds/fillrect protected-area setup, the centered 29x13 map and all callback descriptors in source order, and the final protected union passed to hell_tweaks(). Verified that Lua coordinates remain map-relative through the des API, that the map's transparent trailing x cells are excluded from the returned map selection, and that no random calls are inserted or reordered. Every des.* operation and hell_tweaks() call used by the source has a production implementation; no unported callee gap remains.

callers.source: mkmaze.c makemaz() resolves the wizard2 special-level name through load_special(); the JavaScript registry imports WIZARD2_LEVEL_LOADERS and merges its wizard2 entry before dispatch.

mkmaze.c makemaz() calls load_special(protofile) for the resolved wizard2 prototype; the JavaScript load_special() invokes the registered wizard2 loader through createSpecialLevelApi() and then runs finish().

entryPointReview: The whole wizard2.lua program is a special-level entry point. Its production path is dungeon.c's wizard2 prototype selection through mkmaze.c makemaz() and sp_lev.c load_special(), represented by js/mklev.js's makemaz(), load_special(), and ensureSpecialLevelLoaders(). The fresh wizard2 level-teleport recording reaches that path and matches C for the complete RNG log, seven screens, and cursor positions.
